Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.gui

Interface GuiLayoutService

public interface GuiLayoutService
GUI ID registration plus configured size, slot, filler, and pagination resolution. Runtime registration is reserved for addon IDs and never replaces a shipped built-in definition.
